paper: 2019 public author draft Eqs1-7; nine-scale robustness of 2024, NOT 2024 main specification
features: 18 ratios trailing inclusive arithmetic MA(close,L)/close_today and MA(CNY amount,L)/amount_today
data: All1709 original manifest stocks, fixed future-selected universe, adjusted stored source close verified against native facts; no second adjustment. Already-consumed historical development data, not untouched OOS.
missing: Common exchange calendar. Require all400 sessions positive finite observed original price/amount, same source segment. No fill-forward, skipped dates or last-month signal imputation. Entire model feature block unknown if incomplete. This is stricter than paper and creates continuous-trading selection; report coverage and keep UNKNOWN original opportunity slots.
training: Each complete month t, cross-section month-t simple adjusted close return vs month-(t-1)-end features. Require positive finite close/source-present full return month, same segment. Min100 stocks, all18 features complete. P9 and PA18 use identical rows.
regularization: Fixed ridge mean squared error +0.01*sum(gamma_standardized^2), intercept unpenalized; monthly predictor mean/std then coefficients converted to raw ratio units before EMA. No winsorization, y cap, hyperparameter scan or result-based revision. Raw coordinate coefficient EMA remains comparable across months. Expose collinearity and right-tail influence.
ema: alpha0.02; first usable beta initializes; require38 completed monthly regressions before prediction. Skipped unsupported months leave beta frozen and do not count warmup.
daily_mapping: At any signal close in month m, use beta EMA only through complete month m-1. Monthly adaptation to daily opportunities, not exact paper replication.
opportunities: Original PVR 53121 legal empty MOBILE account-conditional opportunities; E0/I/CP/source account states unchanged; original global topK=min20,N fixes each sector K. Alternatives only reorder common feature-known slots inside sector. UNKNOWN positions fixed. H1 is existing original_H1, no refit.
evaluation: Seal scores and picks before separately reading fixed native future price labels. 5/20/60 horizons; primary60. Same-date union-complete selected rows all arms; raw, minus40bp and100bp proxies, positive proportions not actual net wins; prior21/63 and acceleration groups, periods2022..26,924 and2026Q1; righttail/root early coverage, fixed60-session block bootstrap.
limits: No PIT universe/industry/action publications, source OHLC proxies, no order execution/limit/suspension correction claimed; no strategy net winrate claim. Eventual35% net win target not tested.
